message.content:
The idea of a “best” movie is always a matter of taste, but there are a few ways to look at it objectively: | Criterion | 2020 Movie(s) that topped the list | |-----------|------------------------------------| | **Highest‑rated on Rotten Tomatoes (Critics Score)** | *The Trial of the Chicago 7* (97 %) | | **Highest‑rated on Metacritic (Critics Score)** | *The Trial of the Chicago 7* (94 / 100) | | **Most‑awarded at major film festivals** | *Nomadland* (won the Palme d’Or at Cannes 2020) | | **Best Picture winner at the 93rd Academy Awards** | *Nomadland* | | **Most‑streamed on major platforms (2020‑2021)** | *The Queen’s Gambit* (TV‑movie, but often grouped with 2020 releases) | | **Highest‑grossing worldwide (adjusted for inflation)** | *Tenet* (though it was released in 2020, its box‑office performance was strong) | ### Why those films stand out | Film | Key achievements | |------|------------------| | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | • 97 % on Rotten Tomatoes, 94 / 100 on Metacritic.
• Won the Grand Jury Prize at Sundance 2020.
• Nominated for 8 Oscars, winning 2 (Best Supporting Actor – Eddie Redmayne, Best Original Screenplay – Aaron Sorkin). | | **Nomadland** | • Won the Palme d’Or at Cannes 2020.
• Won Best Picture, Best Director (Chloé Zhao), and Best Actress (Frances McDormand) at the Oscars.
• 96 % on Rotten Tomatoes, 88 / 100 on Metacritic. | | **Soul** | • 98 % on Rotten Tomatoes, 88 / 100 on Metacritic.
• Won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
• Critically acclaimed for its music and storytelling. | | **Tenet** | • 70 % on Rotten Tomatoes, 68 / 100 on Metacritic.
• Highest‑grossing film of 2020 worldwide (≈$363 million). | | **The Queen’s Gambit** | • 99 % on Rotten Tomatoes, 84 / 100 on Metacritic.
• Became the most‑watched original series on Netflix in 2020. | ### How to decide for yourself 1. **Pick a metric** – Do you care more about critical consensus, awards, box‑office, or streaming popularity? 2. **Consider genre** – If you’re into dramas, *Nomadland* and *The Trial of the Chicago 7* are strong choices. For animation, *Soul* is a standout. 3. **Check your platform** – Some films are only available on certain streaming services or require a theater ticket. If you’re looking for a single “best” film, many critics and award bodies point to **Nomadland** as the most celebrated 2020 release, largely because it won the Academy Award for Best Picture and the Palme d’Or at Cannes. However, if you prefer a film with the highest critical scores, *The Trial of the Chicago 7* tops the Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic charts.
